scope: Two predeclared independent fixed-truth mocks; bounded recovery stress test, not a coverage estimate or SBC

recovery.quantities: All five physical scalars; initial-field projection truth and predictive residuals also reported
recovery.policy: Describe ranks, offsets and central interval inclusion for every outcome. Interval misses are not automatic failures and must not trigger retuning. Recovery summaries provisional if mixing fails; no pooling across mocks.

stopping: All eight fresh chains complete their fixed budgets. Preserve all failed and successful mocks. No new draws until pass or seed replacement.
limits: Only two new realizations, no meaningful coverage frequency calibration
Fixed scalar truth is not prior-predictive SBC
Source numerical stability covers one original mock; optional mock sensitivity requires a separately declared check
Serial replica-exchange validation; production MPI replica layouts remain open
